title: Ayashimon
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Maruo Kaido, a teenage manga fan who trained himself to superhuman strength by copying manga training, wants to live like a manga hero. He rescues Urara, an oni yokai being chased by a yokai yakuza gang, and she recruits him as the first member of her own yakuza family. The short Weekly Shonen Jump run (2021-2022) follows their brawls with rival yokai gangs.
life_message: It holds up loyalty to one's chosen crew, keeping one's word and fighting fairly as the path to living like a hero.

content.note: Gang brawls between yokai and Maruo are the core (Wikipedia plot; AniList Yakuza 94%, Action); shonen-style, gore not flagged.
Monster yokai and gang threats played mostly for action and comedy (to verify).
Maruo's crush on Urara is light; MangaDex rates it safe.
Gangster bluster and insults typical of shonen (to verify).
Not flagged; yakuza setting may show drinking or smoking (to verify).
Joining a yakuza family is the hero's dream; extreme self-training shown as admirable (Wikipedia plot).
Meta jokes about Jump manga tropes (AniList Meta 73%).

dominant: Might makes right; loyalty and honor codes (virtue ethics); communitarian crew bonds
